summary: Full backend + frontend verification of PWA QR cross-device login feature. All requested acceptance criteria pass: qr generate requires auth, qr claim returns user+JWT that works on /auth/me, single-use enforcement (reuse=401), invalid=401. Frontend QR login card renders on dashboard with QR SVG, timer countdown, and working refresh. Downloads page shows android/ios/desktop QR + all 3 download buttons. End-to-end QR claim in a fresh browser context auto-authenticates, shows success testid and redirects to /dashboard; reuse of the same URL in another fresh context shows qr-claim-error. Mobile viewport (390x844) shows top bar + hamburger, drawer opens, nav item navigates & closes drawer, close button closes drawer. Desktop regression: all nav links visible, logout redirects to /login.
critical_code_review_comments: QrLoginCard auto-refresh loop is fine but note: when the tab is backgrounded, setTimeout throttling can drift the visible countdown; consider using an absolute expiry timestamp diff instead of decrementing state.
Downloads page 'Download .exe/.dmg/.AppImage' buttons currently open https://github.com/ (placeholder). Confirm this is intentional for MVP; real artifacts not wired yet.

QrClaim stores token in localStorage but the backend already sets an httpOnly cookie on claim — duplication is fine but ensure the axios client attaches Bearer from localStorage consistently across reloads.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded demo user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: QR login feature is fully working end-to-end. Backend endpoints: POST /api/auth/qr/generate (auth required, returns {token, expires_in_seconds:180}) and POST /api/auth/qr/claim (no auth, returns {user, JWT token}). QR tokens are single-use and 3-min TTL. Frontend testids: qr-login-card, qr-login-code, qr-login-timer, qr-login-refresh, qr-claim-success, qr-claim-error, mobile-qr-android, mobile-qr-ios, desktop-qr, download-btn-{windows,macos,linux}, mobile-topbar, mobile-menu-button, mobile-close-button, sidebar.
